name: imon-motion
description: AI-native motion production monorepo with routed donor knowledge, normalized motion primitives, Creative Director protocol and Remotion runtime kit

scripts.bootstrap: npm run upstream:sync && npm run index:build && npm run license:audit
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/motion-core/test/*.test.ts adapters/product-capture/test/*.test.ts adapters/remotion-three/test/*.test.ts adapters/audio-analysis/test/*.test.ts adapters/webgl/test/*.test.ts
scripts.ci: npm run license:audit && npm run system:validate && npm run extensions:validate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run studio:compositions
